_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on the Custom Source Engine Game egg in https://github.com/pterodactyl/panel (MIT).
name: Custom Source game
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Any game or mod on Valve's Source engine that SteamCMD can download anonymously, by its dedicated server's Steam app ID, such as Half-Life 2: Deathmatch or Day of Defeat: Source. Installs it with SteamCMD and keeps it updated.
startup: if [ "{{AUTO_UPDATE}}" = 1 ]; then ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /home/container +login anonymous +app_update {{SRCDS_APPID}} ${SRCDS_BETAID:+-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID"} ${SRCDS_BETAPASS:+-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS"} $([ "{{VALIDATE}}" = 1 ] && echo validate) +quit || echo "Steam couldn't update the game, so the server starts as it is."; fi; if [ -x srcds_run_64 ]; then run=./srcds_run_64; else run=./srcds_run; fi; exec $run -game {{SRCDS_GAME}} -console -norestart -strictportbind -ip 0.0.0.0 -port {{SERVER_PORT}} +maxplayers {{MAX_PLAYERS}} +map {{SRCDS_MAP}} ${STEAM_ACC:++sv_setsteamaccount $STEAM_ACC} {{ARGS}}

config.startup: {"done": "regex:Connection to Steam servers successful|gameserver Steam ID"}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Custom Source game. Installs or updates the dedicated server (any Steam app ID) with
# SteamCMD, signed in anonymously. Files the game doesn't ship (configs, maps,
# addons) are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
export HOME=/mnt/server
app="${SRCDS_APPID:?Set Steam app ID.}"
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

# SteamCMD stays in the server folder, so the server can update itself at start.
if [ ! -x steamcmd/steamcmd.sh ]; then
    echo "Downloading SteamCMD"
    mkdir -p steamcmd
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz | tar -xz -C steamcmd
fi
mkdir -p steamapps
args=(+force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_update "$app")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAID:-}" ] || args+=(-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAPASS:-}" ] || args+=(-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS")
[ "${VALIDATE:-0}" != 1 ] || args+=(validate)
# SteamCMD often fails once for no lasting reason (Missing configuration,
# state 0x202 or 0x602 after it updates itself): try again, up to 5 times.
for try in 1 2 3 4 5; do
    ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh "${args[@]}" +quit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/steamcmd.log || true
    grep -aq "Success! App '$app'" /tmp/steamcmd.log && break
    err=$(grep -aE '^(ERROR|Error)!' /tmp/steamcmd.log | tail -n 1) || true
    case "$err" in
    *"No subscription"*) fail "Steam won't give this game to an anonymous account, so it can't be installed." ;;
    *"Invalid Password"* | *"Invalid beta"*) fail "Steam refused the beta branch or its password. Check Beta branch and Beta password, then reinstall." ;;
    esac
    [ "$try" = 5 ] && fail "SteamCMD failed 5 times (${err:-no error given}). If it mentions 0x202, the server may be out of disk space. Reinstall to try again."
    echo "SteamCMD failed; trying again ($((try + 1)) of 5)."
    sleep 5
done
# Steam's client library, where the game looks for it.
mkdir -p .steam/sdk32 .steam/sdk64
cp -f steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so .steam/sdk32/
cp -f steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so .steam/sdk64/
build=$(sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*"buildid"[[:space:]]*"\([0-9]*\)".*/\1/p' "steamapps/appmanifest_$app.acf" | head -n 1)

[ -d "${SRCDS_GAME:-}" ] || echo "The game installed, but has no folder named ${SRCDS_GAME:-(empty)}. Set Game folder to the folder the game keeps its maps and cfg in."
echo "Installed Steam app $app build ${build:-unknown}${SRCDS_BETAID:+ from the $SRCDS_BETAID branch}."

variables.name: Steam app ID
variables.description: The dedicated server's Steam app ID, such as 232370 for Half-Life 2: Deathmatch. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Game folder
variables.description: The game's folder (srcds -game), such as hl2mp, dod or cstrike.

variables.name: Map
variables.description: The map the server starts on.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: How many players can be on the server at once.

variables.name: Game server token
variables.description: A game server login token from steamcommunity.com/dev/managegameservers, for games that want one.

variables.name: Extra arguments
variables.description: More srcds options, such as +sv_lan 0, added at the end.

variables.name: Auto update
variables.description: Update the game from Steam every time the server starts.

variables.name: Validate files
variables.description: Check every game file against Steam when installing or updating, which repairs damaged files but takes longer.

variables.name: Beta branch
variables.description: The Steam beta branch to install, or empty for the normal release. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Beta password
variables.description: The password of a private beta branch, if it has one.
